description:
There are No Ghosts at the Grand is an upcoming, musical, Lovecraftian, renovation game, developed by Friday Sundae.

In the game, players work to restore a peaceful English hotel by day, and encounter the sinister and Lovecraftian creatures by night. Meet a variety of characters and uncover a deep story with humor, a musical flair and plenty of twists and turns.

With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a supernatural plot,  Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

description:
On this episode of the Official Xbox Podcast, we're flying high and diving deep into the just announced single player story mode of Invincible VS. Executive Producer Mike Willette joins to share gameplay from the story mode, talk about the characters, share the story behind Ella Mental's creation, and a bunch of other behind the scenes information.

00:00 Introduction
01:57 How are you and the team feeling?
03:22 Live React: Invincible VS Story Mode trailer
05:42 What is Story Mode?
09:28 Live React: Story Mode gameplay
15:43 What can you tell us about the new character Ella Mental voiced by Tierra Whack and how she came to be?
18:32 And now Ella Mental is going to be showing up in the comic world?
19:33 What can you tell us about the additional lineup of characters that have been announced?
20:05 Jeff's pitch for an Invincible VS character
20:55 And there's an Arcade Mode with character progression and collectibles?
22:25 What are you most excited for players to discover when playing
title: Invincible VS Story Mode Deep Dive: Fight To Save The World | Official Xbox Podcast
